content.short: Orbital is a B2B stablecoin payments platform with virtual IBANs, wallets, pay-ins, payouts and exchange.
content.description: Orbital is a global payments platform that bridges stablecoins and traditional finance for businesses moving money across borders. It gives companies named virtual IBANs, stablecoin and fiat wallets, pay-ins to receive funds in many currencies, payouts in stablecoins or fiat, and exchange across traditional, exotic and stablecoin currencies. Orbital supports major stablecoins such as USDT and USDC and integrates with partners including Circle and Binance Pay, with regulatory registrations in the UK, Gibraltar, Estonia and Switzerland. Serving enterprises, marketplaces and payment providers, it has processed around 12 billion dollars in annualized value, offering faster, cheaper international settlement than correspondent banking.
content.meta: Orbital bridges stablecoins and banking with vIBANs, pay-ins and payouts for business. Discover Orbital and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
